title: Require detached launcher readiness before promising mailbox completion
outcome: Parent-consolidated dual review 2026-09-22, Codex session-7272 and Claude session-7273; reviewed fingerprint 105d17771f7afa7df75efb3448832b9f7f8303b8fe850f159601b6d5f792e505. Both reviewers found STARTED follows only Node spawn, before notification eligibility or execution admission. Self-send, missing genuine sender, invalid CLI, lock/read/save startup exceptions can leave the coordinator waiting without a wake. Validate notification prerequisites before detach, and require child readiness after exclusive admission and initial state validation. Handle owned startup failures with terminal evidence and best-effort notification when recipient is known. Never overwrite another run owner on EEXIST; unreadable request/recipient must fail visibly before STARTED. Preserve exactly-once execution and notify-only retry. Validate trimmed nonempty non-option-like recipients without forbidding supported session names. Add real detached failure/readiness regressions; OS kill/network failure still cannot guarantee delivery.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect1 batch 1a, spot-checked by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-DONE. Launcher readiness comes before STARTED, and post-READY death is covered by `recover` (scripts/test-launcher.mjs:623, :934 on master f7db2c58). Closed by evidence.
